audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 and Level 3 read Vladimir in both layers; the packet chart has the first five rows as Skill and the mirror already set rows 1 and 2 to Skill from Vladimir's side.
audit.why: The content whys for those rows already read 'stays neutral' and 'is even/skill', so the tokens contradicted their own explanations.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side and win[2]/phases[2].side -> Skill, as one atomic group. Ratings already read 5/10 and stay.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike credited Zaahen's R with lockdown and gave no cooldown for Hemoplague or Sanguine Pool.
audit.why: Riot's text for Zaahen's R is rise, stab, heal for a portion of damage dealt — no CC. Hemoplague is a flat 120s; Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and whys[4] rewritten around the heal and the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool was described only as 'dodges your burst' with no duration or cooldown, and Tides of Blood's blocked-by-units property was never stated anywhere despite being the single cheapest way to take zero poke in this lane.
audit.why: Pool is untargetable for 2 seconds on 28/25/22/19/16s — the window is short and long-punishable. Riot's E text says the released blood 'can be blocked by enemy units', so standing behind your own caster minions eats the cast. Transfusion costs no mana and heals off you on 9s at rank 1, which is what makes anti-heal mandatory (flagged in missingInteractions).
audit.corrected: dosFull[0..2].d, dontsFull[0..2].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the durations, the cooldowns, the minion block and the Grievous Wounds timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appeared as a title with placeholder text under it.
audit.why: Both Transfusion and Hemoplague heal him; Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names Executioner's and both healing sources.

edits.before: Level 6 stays even — his Hemoplague amp versus your R lockdown comes down to execution.
edits.after: Level 6 stays even — his Hemoplague amp versus your R's heal comes down to execution.

edits.before: Level 6 stays a skill check — his Hemoplague (R) amps all damage on you but he lacks hard lockdown, while your R Final Retribution can catch him if he mis-times Sanguine Pool (W); whoever lands their ult combo cleanly takes the trade.
edits.after: Level 6 stays a skill check — Hemoplague (R, 120s) amps every point of damage on you but gives him no lockdown, while your R heals off the damage it deals and lands if he mis-times Sanguine Pool (W, 28s at rank 1); whoever ults cleanly takes it.

edits.before: Dodges your burst. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Untargetable 2s, 28s at rank 1. Commit only once it is spent.

edits.before: Probe Vladimir's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Transfusion costs him nothing and heals off you — deny the last hit he wants, and he pays health for every E cast.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Executioner's before your first long trade — Q and R both heal him.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Pool is untargetable for 2 seconds — hold your R until those 2 seconds are gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: 2s untargetable eats one-shot burst — sustained damage beats it.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Every wave he farms free is AP that Crimson Pact turns into health — kill his tempo early.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your burst. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: 28/25/22/19/16s, untargetable 2s — commit only once it is spent. - Transfusion: 9s at rank 1, free healing off you. - Tides of Blood: blocked by units; stand behind minions. - Your R: kill windows.

notes: Zaahen's R was again described as lockdown; the kit gives it damage and a heal only. The mirror audit reports Zaahen's real names as Grim Deliverance (R) and Aureate Rush (E), taken from missing-interactions records — this direction's prose still says 'Final Retribution' and 'Golden Onslaught' in several places. I removed 'Final Retribution' where the sentence was being rewritten anyway, but a full rename across both layers is a ~15-string change that should be decided once for the whole champion rather than piecemeal per matchup.
